title: Final delimiter of an action encoding
statement: Let $k,n\in\mathbb{N}$, let $F$ be a machine format, and let $a$ be an action for a $k$-work-tape machine with binary tape alphabet and state space $\{0,\ldots,n\}$. The bit string encoding $a$ by the specified serialization of its input move, work-tape instructions, output, and optional successor state ends in the bit $0$.
hypotheses_covered: An action for a $k$-work-tape binary machine with state space $\{0,\ldots,n\}$
